function.name: GifFrameEncode_SetSize
function.description: This function sets the size of a GIF frame. It first checks if the width and height are valid. If they are, it enters a critical section and checks if the frame is initialized. If it is, it frees the existing image data and allocates new memory for the image data. It then sets the width and height of the frame and returns a success status. If the frame is not initialized, it returns an error status. It leaves the critical section before returning.

parameters.description: This is an interface to a bitmap frame encoder.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: This is the width of the GIF frame.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: This is the height of the GIF frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be S_OK for success, E_INVALIDARG if the width or height is zero, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is not initialized.

parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap frame that needs its resolution set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the frame is not initialized.

function.name: GifFrameEncode_WritePixels
function.description: This function encodes the pixel data for a GIF frame. It checks if the pixel data is valid, then enters a critical section to prevent other threads from accessing the shared resource. If the frame is initialized and has image data, it copies the pixel data into the image data. If the number of lines to be written exceeds the frame's height, it returns an error. If the frame is not initialized or has no image data, it returns an error indicating the wrong state. Finally, it leaves the critical section and returns the result.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Number of lines to write

parameters.description: Stride of the pixel data

parameters.name: size

parameters.name: pixels
parameters.description: Pointer to the pixel data to write

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. It can be S_OK if the function succeeds, E_INVALIDARG if the arguments are invalid, or WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the function is in the wrong state to perform the operation

function.name: lzw_output_code
function.description: This function is used to output the LZW (Lempel-Ziv-Welch) code. It shifts the code to the left by the number of bits specified in the state's bits_count, adds the number of code bits to the bits_count, and then writes the least significant byte of the bits buffer to the user data. If the write operation is not successful, it returns 0. Otherwise, it shifts the bits buffer to the right by 8 bits and subtracts 8 from the bits_count, repeating this process until the bits_count is less than 8.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the LZW state structure, which contains the bits buffer, bits count, code bits, user write data function, and user pointer.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: This is the LZW code to be output.

function.return_type: int. This function returns 1 if the LZW code is successfully output, or 0 if the write operation is not successful.

function.name: lzw_flush_bits
function.description: This function flushes the bits stored in the lzw_state structure. If the number of bits is greater than or equal to 8, it writes the bits to the user data. If there are remaining bits, it masks them and writes them to the user data. Finally, it resets the bits buffer and count in the lzw_state structure.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the lzw_state structure that contains the bits to be flushed.

function.return_type: int, represents whether the function was successful in flushing the bits. Returns 1 if successful, 0 otherwise.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: This parameter represents the number of bytes to be written.

function.return_type: int, represents the number of bytes written if successful, or 0 if a write operation failed.

function.name: flush_output_data
function.description: This function writes the gif block from the output stream to the output. If the gif block length is not zero, it writes the gif block and its length to the output. It then sets the gif block length to zero and writes the gif block length to the output again. The function returns whether the last write operation was successful.

parameters.name: user_ptr
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the output stream structure.

function.return_type: int, represents whether the last write operation was successful (1 for success, 0 for failure)

function.name: read_byte
function.description: This function reads a byte from the input stream and decreases the length of the stream by one. If the stream length is zero, it returns 0.

parameters.name: in
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the input stream from which the byte is read.

parameters.name: byte
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the byte that is read from the input stream.

function.return_type: int, represents whether a byte was successfully read from the input stream. Returns 1 if a byte was read, and 0 if the stream length was zero.

function.name: gif_compress
function.description: This function compresses GIF data using the LZW (Lempel–Ziv–Welch) compression algorithm. It reads input data byte by byte, and writes the compressed data to an output stream.

parameters.name: out_stream
parameters.description: This is the output stream where the compressed data is written.

parameters.name: in_data
parameters.description: This is the input data that needs to be compressed.

parameters.name: in_size
parameters.description: This is the size of the input data.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_FAIL if the operation fails at any point.

function.name: GifFrameEncode_Commit
function.description: This function commits a GIF frame encoding. It writes the logical screen descriptor, global color table, image descriptor, local color table, and image data to the encoder's stream. It also handles synchronization with a critical section.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the bitmap frame that needs to be encoded.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the function is in an incorrect state for the operation.

function.name: GifFrameEncode_GetMetadataQueryWriter
function.description: This function retrieves a metadata query writer for a GIF frame encode interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface that represents the GIF frame to encode.

parameters.name: writer
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICMetadataQueryWriter interface. This parameter receives the interface pointer of the metadata query writer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the writer parameter is NULL, WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the encode object is not initialized, or the result of the MetadataQueryWriter_CreateInstanceFromBlockWriter function.

function.name: GifEncoder_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the IUnknown or IWICBitmapEncoder interface. If it does, it increments the reference count of the interface and returns a pointer to it. If the interface does not support either interface, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface to be checked

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface to be checked against

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface supports the requested interface, E_NOINTERFACE if it does not, and E_INVALIDARG if the ppv parameter is NULL

function.name: GifEncoder_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the GifEncoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapEncoder interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: GifEncoder_Release
function.description: This function releases the GifEncoder object and its associated resources. It decrements the reference count and if it reaches zero, it releases the stream, deletes the critical section, and frees the memory allocated for the GifEncoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IWICBitmapEncoder interface that is used to access the GifEncoder object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after decrement. If it is zero, it means that the object has been released.

function.name: GifEncoder_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a GIF encoder. If the encoder is already initialized, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the bitmap encoder

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream to which the GIF encoder writes

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: Options for caching during encoding

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the initialization is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the encoder is already initialized, and E_INVALIDARG if the stream is null

function.name: GifEncoder_GetContainerFormat
function.description: This function checks if the format is null, if not, it sets the format to GUID_ContainerFormatGif and returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapEncoder interface

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID to receive the container format

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the format is null, otherwise it returns S_OK.

function.name: GifEncoder_GetEncoderInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the encoder information for a GIF encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for a bitmap encoder.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the encoder information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the return value is S_OK. If the 'info' parameter is NULL, the function returns E_INVALIDARG. If the operation fails for other reasons, it returns an error code.

function.name: GifEncoder_SetColorContexts

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the bitmap encoder

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of color contexts

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Pointer to the color context

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: GifEncoder_SetPalette
function.description: This function sets the palette for a GIF encoder. It checks if the palette is initialized and gets the colors if it is, otherwise it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for a Windows Imaging Component (WIC) bitmap encoder. Used to convert bitmap data to an encoded image stream.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Interface for a WIC palette. Used to define a custom color palette for the GIF encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the palette is not initialized, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED. If the palette is null, it returns E_INVALIDARG.

function.name: GifEncoder_SetThumbnail
function.description: This function is designed to set the thumbnail for a GIF encoder, but it currently returns an unsupported operation error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap encoder.

parameters.name: thumbnail
parameters.description: This is the source of the bitmap for the thumbnail.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating the operation is not supported.

function.name: GifEncoder_SetPreview
function.description: This function sets the preview for a GIF encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap encoder.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: This is the source of the bitmap for the preview.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: GifEncoderFrame_Block_QueryInterface

function.name: GifEncoder_CreateNewFrame
function.description: This function creates a new frame for a GIF encoder. It checks if the encoder is initialized and not committed, then allocates memory for a new frame and initializes its properties. If the options parameter is not null, it creates a property bag. If any step fails, it releases the frame and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapEncoder interface that represents the GIF encoder.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameEncode interface that will receive the new frame.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IPropertyBag2 interface that will receive the property bag, if it is created.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the frame parameter is null, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the encoder is not in the correct state.

function.name: GifEncoder_Commit
function.description: This function commits the GIF encoder. It writes a GIF trailer to the stream if the encoder is initialized and not yet committed. If the encoder is not in the correct state, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the WIC bitmap encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the encoder is not in the correct state.
